findings.title: Netcapital artificially inflated its reported revenue and net income by recognizing overvalued, non-cash, equity-settled
findings.description: Netcapital artificially inflated its reported revenue and net income by recognizing overvalued, non-cash, equity-settled consulting fees from counterparties, creating a massive divergence between reported earnings and actual cash flows.

findings.title: Consistent with Netcapital's established business model of accepting customer equity in lieu of cash, the revenues from
findings.description: Consistent with Netcapital's established business model of accepting customer equity in lieu of cash, the revenues from AceHedge LLC, Fantize LLC, and StockText LLC were recognized as accounts receivable and subsequently settled in issuer equity units, and these entities represent crowdfunding issuers launched on Netcapital's own portal.
